verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP GET/POST to the reported file-serving servlet; all cases run in-process against the real servlet entry points with a recording response
routes: FileServer GET/POST with no ComponentId -> resolves under the uploads root's null directory and serves it
FileServer GET/POST with an entitled ComponentId and an absolute SourceFile plus the TypeUpload marker -> opens the absolute path
verified.project_tests_run: mvn -pl core-library -Dtest=FileServerUtilsTest test at the pinned commit

reproduced_on_pinned.T1: GET and POST with no ComponentId returned the file under the uploads root null directory (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T2: GET and POST with an entitled ComponentId, an absolute SourceFile and the absolute-location marker returned the outside file (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T3: anonymous, unentitled and no-ComponentId requests returned the sibling servlet file (marker in the response body)
reproduced_on_pinned.T5: storage sharing with a non-member works on the pinned code and is the functional value the over-hardening patch breaks

verified.local_proof: control pinned 4/4 security fail and 7/7 functional pass; upstream reference 4/4 + 7/7 pass

traps.shape: a download request that supplies no space identifier; the server treats it as a supported personal-space request and serves the file under the uploads root's null directory
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the allow-branch is commented 'Personal space' and the framework's own controller also authorises a null component id

traps.shape: an absolute file location supplied in the request while the absolute-location marker is present; the descriptor skips the component repository and opens the location directly
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the marker reads like an internal flag of the product's own URL builders, and a caller with an entitled space is already authorised

patch_checks.why: blind fix produced by the blind-fix step after the first gate

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the control contains only the reported route, so there is no second route to reach through a neighbouring resource
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected operation is a file read; the reported route writes nothing
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the only adjustment (a size or directory prefix) is part of the path the shared traversal processor checks
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control contains only the reported route
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the gate and the resolver read the same parameter map
